guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, done_valid is cleared to 0.
When absorbed_o is true (mubi4 strict) and not in reset, done_valid is set to 1.
When done_i is true (mubi4 strict) and absorbed_o is not true (and not in reset), done_valid is cleared to 0.
guarantees.cond: if !rst_ni and not absorbed_o and done_i true

guarantees.claim: When none of the triggering conditions (reset, absorbed_o, done_i) is true, done_valid holds its previous value.

assumptions.claim: absorbed_o must be driven with a valid mubi4 encoding that is true (strict) whenever the SHA3 padder has finished absorbing a block.
assumptions.risk: If absorbed_o is invalid or deasserted while absorption is complete, done_valid will not be set, stalling downstream logic.

assumptions.claim: done_i must be driven with a valid mubi4 encoding that is true (strict) whenever the downstream consumer has accepted the absorption event and the done flag should be cleared.
assumptions.risk: If done_i is invalid or deasserted while a clear is expected, done_valid will not be cleared, causing a possible protocol deadlock.

uncertain_points.claim: If absorbed_o and done_i are both true (strict mubi4) in the same cycle, absorbed_o takes priority and done_valid is set to 1, ignoring done_i. The intended handshake behavior when both events coincide is unclear.
uncertain_points.cond: when absorbed_o and done_i are simultaneously true
uncertain_points.risk: Could prevent done_valid from being cleared in a timely manner, potentially causing a protocol deadlock or a missed done handshake cycle.
